$comment: Single source of truth for all Windows MIDI Services App SDK version numbers.
build.ps1 stamps this into the NuGet nuspec, AppSdkVersion.wxi, the PowerShell module
manifest, and every MSBuild Version/FileVersion/AssemblyVersion property.
Do not hand-edit versions anywhere else.
0.99.57-devpreview.5. Bump 'patch' for each release; that is what makes builds distinct.
build:         4th field of the numeric assembly/file/MSI version only. It does NOT appear
in the SemVer string. CI can override with -BuildNumber <n> without touching
this file; -BumpBuildNumber increments and persists it.
IMPORTANT: Windows Installer only compares the first THREE fields of a version.
Bump 'patch' for any release that must upgrade over a previously installed one.
